    - heading "Apple Vision Pro" [level=1]:
      - text: Apple Vision Pro
      - figure
    - heading "New powerful M5 chip and comfortable Dual Knit Band." [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - link "Book a demo of Apple Vision Pro":
          - /url: /retail/instore-shopping-session/session-selection/?topic=visionpro
          - text: Book a demo

    - img "Person wearing Apple Vision Pro, assembled with Dual Knit Band"
    - list:
      - listitem: Apple Vision Pro seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space.
      - listitem: So you can work, watch, relive memories, and connect in ways never before possible.
      - listitem: The era of spatial computing is here.
    - img "People interacting with Apple Vision Pro, including a user viewing Home View apps floating in space in a living room, a user standing in front of a massive screen showing a city skyline in a living room, a user viewing a movie on an airplane, a close-up view of the Clock widget on a living room wall, a user interacting with a Persona in a living room, and a user playing a game using handheld controllers in a living room animation"
    - button "Intro to Apple Vision Pro animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph:
      - link "stream wolfs on apple tv with a subscription, Opens in new window":
        - /url: https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/wolfs/umc.cmc.c3xhu25rw4jxxxzq4oio6snu?itscg=10000&itsct=atv--vision_pro-stream5-apl-251015
        - text: Stream
        - emphasis: Wolfs
        - text: on Apple TV with a subscription 
    - paragraph: PlayStation VR2 Sense controller sold separately.
    - heading "Take a closer look." [level=2]
    - list "design gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro rotates from front view to side view, showing the form of the device and Dual Knit Band in detail animation"
        - button "Design innovation animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro is the result of decades of high‑performance, mobile, and wearable device innovation. Its advanced technology and elegant form deliver an amazing experience every time you put it on.
      - listitem:
        - img "Person wearing Apple Vision Pro, assembled with Dual Knit Band, upper band spans across the top of the head, one hand placed on lower back band behind head, other hand placed on aluminum alloy frame"
        - paragraph: The new Dual Knit Band combines soft, breathable straps with a counterbalanced design, so you can stay immersed in your favorite spatial experiences longer.
      - listitem:
        - img "Close-up of fingers adjusting the Fit Dial on the Dual Knit Band, fingers pull out the dial and turn it, the lower back band constricts, fingers turn the Fit Dial and the upper top band constricts animation"
        - button "Dual-function Fit Dial animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: The dual-function Fit Dial lets you easily adjust the band’s upper and lower straps independently for a comfortable, personalized fit.
      - listitem:
        - img "Light Seal magnetically connecting to the aluminum enclosure of Apple Vision Pro animation"
        - button "Light Seal attachment animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: The Light Seal magnetically attaches to the aluminum alloy frame and gently flexes to conform to your face, delivering a precise fit while blocking out stray light.
      - listitem:
        - img "Close-up side view of Apple Vision Pro showing Audio Strap"
        - paragraph: Speakers positioned close to your ears deliver rich Spatial Audio that seamlessly blends with real‑world sounds, keeping you aware of your surroundings.
      - listitem:
        - img "Close-up side view of Apple Vision Pro showing Digital Crown"
        - paragraph: Press the Digital Crown to bring up the Home View, and turn it to control your level of immersion while using Environments.
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro battery, exterior, centered Apple logo, built-in power cable with round connector at one end, LED indicator on connector"
        - paragraph:
          - text: Apple Vision Pro is powered by an external, aluminum‑encased battery that you can slip into your pocket. It supports up to 2.5 hours of general use and up to 3 hours of video playback.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 1":
              - /url: "#footnote-1"
              - text: "1"
      - listitem:
        - img "ZEISS Optical Inserts, round lenses with black frames"
        - paragraph:
          - text: ZEISS Optical Inserts can be customized with your vision prescription,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 2":
              - /url: "#footnote-2"
              - text: "2"
          - text: and they attach to the lenses magnetically for precise viewing and eye tracking.
      - listitem:
        - img "Side view of Solo Knit Band showing Fit Dial and adjustable back band with ribbed structure"
        - paragraph: The optional Solo Knit Band provides cushioning, breathability, and stretch.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, design gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, design gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Entertainment" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The ultimate theater. Wherever you are.
    - img "Video of people using Apple Vision Pro to watch movies and play video games"
    - button "Entertainment animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph:
      - link "stream wolfs on apple tv with a subscription, Opens in new window":
        - /url: https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/wolfs/umc.cmc.c3xhu25rw4jxxxzq4oio6snu?itscg=10000&itsct=atv--vision_pro-stream5-apl-251015
        - text: Stream
        - emphasis: Wolfs
        - text: on Apple TV with a subscription 
    - paragraph: Transform any room into your own personal theater — with more pixels than a 4K TV for each eye. Experience mind‑blowing immersion with Spatial Audio and expand movies, shows, and games on a giant screen. Whether you’re on the couch or a long flight, enjoy stunning content anywhere.
    - list "entertainment gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro user watches an Apple Immersive Video of a scuba diver interacting with sharks on the sea floor animation"
        - button "Immersive Video animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Apple Immersive Video is a 180-degree, 3D 8K recording format captured with Spatial Audio — putting you right inside the action and transporting you to places you’ve never been.
      - listitem:
        - img "Several spatial photos and videos available in the Spatial Gallery app of Apple Vision Pro animation"
        - button "Spatial gallery app animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Immerse yourself with the Spatial Gallery app — an evolving collection of spatial photos, videos, and panoramas curated by Apple. Discover unique perspectives from trailblazing creators, stories from iconic brands, and behind-the-scenes moments from Apple Music and Apple TV.
      - listitem:
        - img "A person playing a game using Apple Vision Pro and PlayStation VR2 Sense controller animation"
        - button "visionOS game animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph:
          - text: visionOS games offer thrilling ways to play using the space around you. With hand tracking at up to 90Hz, spatial games feel more fluid and responsive than ever. You can also experience select games, like
          - emphasis: Pickle Pro
          - text: ", in six degrees of freedom using the PlayStation VR2 Sense controller."
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 3":
              - /url: "#footnote-3"
              - text: "3"
      - listitem:
        - img "The Apple TV experience of Apple Vision Pro is displayed in a living room, with a still image from the Apple TV series Chief of War"
        - paragraph:
          - text: Enjoy your favorite movies and TV shows from Apple TV and other streaming services. Even watch them with friends using Apple Vision Pro in the same room.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 4":
              - /url: "#footnote-4"
              - text: "4"
      - listitem:
        - img "Person seated on an airplane wearing Apple Vision Pro assembled with Dual Knit Band"
        - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro is fantastic on the move. With Travel Mode, whatever you’re watching will feel smooth — whether on a train, bus, car, or at 30,000 feet. And you can seamlessly pair AirPods Pro with Apple Vision Pro so you can focus on what you’re watching.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, entertainment gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, entertainment gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Productivity" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A workspace with infinite space.
    - img "Animation of a person with Apple Vision Pro interacting with three individuals, an enrollment growth chart displaying virtually in the background, including a user wearing Apple Vision Pro on a couch in a living room using a hand gesture to change their aspect ratio view in Mac Virtual Display"
    - button "Productivity animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph:
      - text: Apple Vision Pro gives you limitless space to do your best work. Bring your Mac workflows into view on a massive screen. Multitask across apps and organize them any way you like. And write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly with Apple Intelligence — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 5":
          - /url: "#footnote-5"
          - text: "5"
    - paragraph:
      - link "Learn more about Apple Intelligence":
        - /url: /apple-intelligence/
        - text: Learn more about Apple Intelligence
    - list "productivity gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Animation of a person wearing Apple Vision Pro on a couch in a living room launches Mac Virtual Display and the screen increases in size, filling the room animation"
        - button "Mac Virtual Display animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph:
          - text: Mac Virtual Display lets you bring your Mac wirelessly into Apple Vision Pro with an expandable, ultrawide screen and rich stereo sound.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 6":
              - /url: "#footnote-6"
              - text: "6"
          - text: It’s the equivalent of having two 5K monitors side by side, creating one massive, curved display — everything looks astoundingly sharp and incredibly detailed.
      - listitem:
        - img "Clock widget on wall showing multiple faces, followed by Calendar widget with April 1 selected, with personalization options to change frame’s thickness and color floating to the right animation"
        - button "arrange your widgets and apps animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: With widgets, you can arrange your favorite information and apps — like Photos, Clock, Music, and Calendar — in your space exactly how you want. Customize their frame thickness, color, and depth, and find them just where you left them, every time you put on Apple Vision Pro.
      - listitem:
        - img "An email written in the Mail app of Apple Vision Pro with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools being used to examine email language"
        - paragraph: With Apple Intelligence, Writing Tools can proofread your text and rewrite versions until the tone and wording are just right, and summarize selected text with a tap. And Smart Reply in Mail and Messages can quickly draft a response with all the right details — identifying key questions and suggesting relevant answers. Usage limits may apply.
        - paragraph:
          - link "Learn more about Apple Intelligence":
            - /url: /apple-intelligence/
      - listitem:
        - img "Two hands positioned over a Magic Keyboard"
        - paragraph: Use Magic Keyboard, Magic Trackpad, and other Bluetooth accessories with Apple Vision Pro. Great for things like complex spreadsheets and long emails.
      - listitem:
        - img "Person wearing Apple Vision Pro uses hand movements to measure a 3D projection of a chair"
        - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro is redefining how businesses run. Collaborate with teams across time zones, build and iterate on prototypes faster, and turn complex training into immersive experiences.
        - paragraph:
          - link "Visit Apple Vision Pro for Enterprise":
            - /url: /business/enterprise/apple-vision-pro/
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, productivity gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, productivity gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Photos and Videos" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Be in the moment. All over again.
    - img "People interacting with Apple Vision Pro to experience the Photos app, including a user watching a 180 degree wide field-of-view photo of city buildings emerging thru a layer of fog, a user viewing a Spatial photo of two young people sitting in a window, and a user viewing a photo of a smiling child holding a tennis racket"
    - button "Photos and videos animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph: With Apple Vision Pro, you can capture magical spatial photos and videos in 3D, then relive those cherished moments all over again. And make your memories come to life by transforming your 2D photos into spatial scenes with just a tap.
    - list "photos and videos gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Photo of a man leaning against an interior courtyard banister, the 2D photo transforming into a spatial scene with more depth and dimension animation"
        - button "Spatial photo animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Instantly transform 2D photos from your photo library into spatial scenes that feel as if you could lean in and look around — bringing memories to life with natural-looking depth and dimension.
      - listitem:
        - img "Demonstrating a Spatial Memory animation"
        - button "Demonstrating Spatial Memory animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Spatial videos and photos have incredible depth that lets you see into a moment. Expand them to get even closer to your favorite memories.
      - listitem:
        - img "A person in a photograph sitting on the floor in a light-filled, wood-paneled room, the words London Memories September 2024 trip shown over the photograph, interface of the memory movie experience in the Photos app of Apple Vision Pro around the photograph and words"
        - paragraph: Apple Intelligence helps you search for photos and videos in the Photos app simply by describing what you’re looking for. And you can revisit your favorite moments by creating a custom memory movie in Photos. Just enter a description, and Apple Intelligence finds the best photos and videos to craft your movie with its own storyline and soundtrack.
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro interface showing video of person paraskiing on a snow-covered mountain, it transitions to full-screen video in wide field of view animation"
        - button "field of view animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: With support for native playback of 360°, 180°, and wide field‑of‑view video captured by action cameras from GoPro, Insta360, and Canon, you can relive and share exciting moments as they were meant to be seen.
      - listitem:
        - img "Close-up view shows the curved top-left corner of Apple Vision Pro, the top button has the same aluminum finish as the Apple Vision Pro frame, the curved glass of the front and part of the top air vent are also shown"
        - paragraph: The top button makes capturing spatial videos or photos quick and easy. EyeSight signals to those around you that you’re recording or taking photos.
      - listitem:
        - img "iPhone 17 Pro, silver, back exterior, pro camera system, three lenses"
        - paragraph:
          - text: You can also take spatial photos and videos on your iPhone, then relive them on Apple Vision Pro.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 7":
              - /url: "#footnote-7"
              - text: "7"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, photos and videos gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, photos and videos gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Connection" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Share quality time. And space.
    - img "Wearing Apple Vision Pro and connecting with others animation"
    - button "Connection animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph: Collaborate and connect wherever you are, in more engaging ways than ever. Make a FaceTime call with others and see them in life-size video tiles. Or use your Persona and feel like coworkers, friends, and family are right there with you.
    - list "connection gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "A woman's Persona that looks natural and realistic while talking animation"
        - button "Persona animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: With striking realism and expressiveness, your Persona lets others see a dynamic, natural representation of you. You can even work together in the same space using apps like Freeform.
      - listitem:
        - img "Two FaceTime tiles float side by side in space, each featuring a different person"
        - paragraph: In FaceTime, each participant appears in your space within a tile that you can adjust in scale. Spatial Audio makes the conversation feel more natural by placing each person’s voice in the location of their tile.
      - listitem:
        - 'img "Photo library in SharePlay interface over Bora Bora Environment, interstitial window with headline SharePlay Photos content displayed, with three buttons that read: SharePlay, Start Only for Me, and Cancel"'
        - paragraph: With SharePlay, you can stream TV shows, movies, and music and play multiplayer games with friends and family, and view photos together during a FaceTime call.
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro Image Playground screen floating in room and creating an image of a yellow cabin"
        - paragraph: Express yourself visually with Image Playground. Create fun and unique images in seconds based on a description, a concept, or even a friend from your Photos library — then share them in Messages or on social media. And create a Genmoji simply by typing a description in the emoji keyboard to match any conversation. All powered by Apple Intelligence. Usage limits may apply.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, connection gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, connection gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Apps" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Do what you love. Reimagine how you do it.
    - img "Animation of Apple Vision Pro users interacting with apps and games"
    - button "Apps animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph: "Featured apps: Kung Fu Panda: School of Chi; Visage Ease VP.* *For informational purposes only. Not for diagnostic use."
    - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro expands the experience of your go‑to apps, making everything from browsing in Safari to chatting in Messages feel more magical. And on the App Store, you’ll discover an ever-growing collection of awe-inspiring spatial apps designed for Apple Vision Pro.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Visit the App Store, Apple Vision Pro":
        - /url: https://apps.apple.com/us/vision
        - text: Visit the App Store
    - list "apps gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "A user wearing Apple Vision Pro on a couch in a living room launching Home View"
        - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro has the familiar apps you know and love — transformed to live in your space. Like Safari, Photos, Music, and Messages. And with iCloud, your content is automatically synced with your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
      - listitem:
        - img "App Store interface shown in Apple Vision Pro"
        - paragraph: The App Store for Apple Vision Pro features groundbreaking apps built for visionOS with powerful spatial experiences, as well as compatible iPad and iPhone apps. Movies, games, sports, fashion, business — it’s all here.
        - paragraph:
          - link "explore apps for apple vision pro":
            - /url: https://apps.apple.com/us/vision
            - text: Explore apps for Apple Vision Pro
      - listitem:
        - img "Apple Vision Pro wearer using Mindfulness app animation"
        - button "Mindfulness animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Apps can expand fully into your space, like during a Mindfulness session, where you can create a private moment of calm.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, apps gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, apps gallery":
          - img
    - heading "visionOS" [level=2]
    - paragraph: An operating system designed for spatial.
    - img "Looking at apps in visionOS animation"
    - button "visionOS animation, loading" [disabled]
    - img
    - paragraph: Built on the foundation of macOS, iOS, and iPadOS, visionOS enables powerful spatial experiences that you navigate naturally using your eyes, hands, and voice. And with the latest visionOS, you’ll discover even more magical ways to watch, work, create, and connect colleagues, friends, and family using Apple Vision Pro.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Learn more about visionOS":
        - /url: /os/visionos/
        - text: Learn more about visionOS
    - list "visionOS gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Multiple apps and widgets floating in living room space including Photos app, Messages app, Calendar widget, and Apple TV app"
        - paragraph: In visionOS, apps fill the space around you, beyond the boundaries of a display. They move anywhere, scale to the perfect size, react to the lighting in your room, and even cast shadows.
      - listitem:
        - img "Thórsmörk Environment in visionOS"
        - paragraph: Environments magically transform your surroundings with stunning 360° landscapes — like Yosemite, Bora Bora, and Jupiter — letting apps grow beyond the dimensions of your room and creating the perfect place to focus.
      - listitem:
        - img "Person wearing Apple Vision Pro, eyes visible through front exterior glass"
        - paragraph: EyeSight lets those nearby know when you’re using apps or fully immersed in an experience. When someone approaches, Apple Vision Pro simultaneously lets you see the person and reveals your eyes to them.
      - listitem:
        - 'img "A hand holding an iPhone, the iPhone screen displays a window with the message: Allow this guest on Apple Vision Pro with buttons labeled: Continue and Decline"'
        - paragraph: Guest User makes it easy to give others access to your Apple Vision Pro, choose which apps they can see, and guide them from your iPhone or iPad with View Mirroring. You can also save your most recent guest’s eye and hand data, so they can skip their next setup and dive back in.
      - listitem:
        - img "Looking at apps in visionOS animation"
        - button "Apps in visionOS animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Navigate visionOS just by looking at apps, buttons, and text fields — and scroll through Safari web pages and other apps using only your eyes.
      - listitem:
        - img "A person seated taps their fingers to trigger an action in visionOS"
        - paragraph: Tap your fingers together to make a selection and gently flick to scroll. Apple Vision Pro is designed to understand hand gestures from comfortable positions, like resting in your lap or on the sofa.
      - listitem:
        - img "Using voice to enter text in a search field animation"
        - button "Using voice animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Simply look at the microphone button in a search field and start speaking to dictate text.
      - listitem:
        - img "Floating gradient Siri AI app icon"
        - paragraph: Use Siri to quickly open or close apps, play media, and more.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous, visionOS gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next, visionOS gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Technology" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Innovation you can see, hear, and feel.
    - heading "Pushing boundaries from the inside out." [level=3]
    - text: Spatial experiences on Apple Vision Pro are only possible through groundbreaking Apple technology. Displays that deliver more pixels than a 4K TV to each eye. Incredible Spatial Audio. A revolutionary dual‑chip design featuring the powerful M5 chip. A sophisticated array of cameras and sensors. All the elements work together to create an unprecedented experience you have to see to believe.
    - figure
    - img "Rear view of Apple Vision Pro showing the displays"
    - heading "More pixels than a 4K TV. For each eye." [level=3]
    - paragraph: The custom micro‑OLED display system features 23 million pixels, delivering stunning resolution and colors. And a specially designed three‑element lens creates the feeling of a display that’s everywhere you look.
    - img "Advanced Spatial Audio analyzes the room you’re in"
    - heading "Our most advanced Spatial Audio system ever." [level=3]
    - paragraph: Dual-driver audio pods positioned next to each ear deliver personalized sound while letting you hear what’s around you. Spatial Audio makes sounds feel like they’re coming from your surroundings. Audio ray tracing analyzes your room’s acoustic properties to adapt and match sound to your space. And if you want to use headphones with Apple Vision Pro, AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods 4 offer the perfect experience — featuring Lossless Audio with ultra-low latency, supported by the H2‑to‑H2 connection across devices.
    - img "Inside view of Apple Vision Pro highlighting the LEDs and infrared cameras that enable precision eye-tracking"
    - heading "Responsive, precision eye tracking." [level=3]
    - paragraph: A high‑performance eye‑tracking system of LEDs and infrared cameras projects invisible light patterns onto each eye. This advanced system provides ultraprecise input, so you can accurately select elements just by looking at them.
    - img "External view of Apple Vision Pro highlighting the array of cameras and sensors"
    - heading "A sophisticated sensor array." [level=3]
    - paragraph: A pair of high-resolution cameras transmit over one billion pixels per second to the displays so you can see the world around you clearly. The system also helps deliver precise head and hand tracking and real‑time 3D mapping, all while understanding your hand gestures from a wide range of positions.
    - img "Technical, exploded view inside Apple Vision Pro highlighting the M5 and R1 chips"
    - heading "Revolutionary dual‑chip performance. Now powered by M5." [level=3]
    - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro makes a giant leap in chip performance with the new M5. It simultaneously runs visionOS, executes advanced computer vision algorithms, and delivers stunning graphics. And the R1 chip is specifically dedicated to process input from the cameras, sensors, and microphones, streaming images to the displays within 12 milliseconds — for a virtually lag‑free, real‑time view of the world. With the extra power and efficiency provided by M5, Apple Vision Pro delivers even more incredible spatial experiences.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Enables up to
      - strong: 120Hz
      - text: refresh rates
    - paragraph:
      - text: Renders
      - strong: 10%
      - text: more pixels
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 8":
          - /url: "#footnote-8"
          - text: "8"
    - paragraph:
      - text: Delivers up to
      - strong: 3 hours
      - text: video playback
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 1":
          - /url: "#footnote-1"
          - text: "1"
    - list "technology gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Multiple app windows displayed in an Environment, including Mail, Image Playground, and Mac Virtual Display"
        - paragraph:
          - text: The M5 chip supercharges Apple Vision Pro to deliver the best spatial experiences yet — including faster load times for apps and widgets, more responsive web browsing, sharper details across text and visuals,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 8":
              - /url: "#footnote-8"
              - text: "8"
          - text: and up to 2x faster AI workloads.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 9":
              - /url: "#footnote-9"

      - listitem:
        - img "Technical, exploded view inside Apple Vision Pro highlighting the thermal system"
        - paragraph: A specially designed thermal system gently moves air through Apple Vision Pro, so it can deliver phenomenal performance while remaining cool and quiet.
      - listitem:
        - img "Technical, exploded view inside Apple Vision Pro highlighting the infrared flood illuminators"
        - paragraph: Infrared flood illuminators work with the external sensors to enhance hand‑tracking performance in low‑light conditions.

    - heading "Values" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Designed to make a difference.
    - heading "Our values lead the way." [level=3]
    - text: Apple Vision Pro was designed to help protect your privacy and keep you in control of your data. Its built‑in accessibility features are designed to work the way you do.
    - list "values gallery":
      - listitem:
        - img "Optic ID scanning iris to authenticate a wearer animation"
        - button "Optic ID animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Use Optic ID to authorize purchases and unlock passwords with the uniqueness of your iris. Optic ID data is private and encrypted, and it never leaves your device. It’s accessible only to the Secure Enclave processor.
      - listitem:
        - img "Icon of an upheld hand inside a circle"
        - paragraph: Data from cameras and sensors is processed at the system level, so individual apps don’t need to see your surroundings to enable spatial experiences.
      - listitem:
        - img "Where you look being blocked from apps and websites animation"
        - button "Where you look animation, loading" [disabled]
        - img
        - paragraph: Eye input is not shared with Apple, third-party apps, or websites. Only your final selections are transmitted when you tap your fingers together.
      - listitem:
        - img "Icon of a human figure with widespread arms inside a circle"
        - paragraph:
          - text: Inclusive by design, Apple Vision Pro comes with built-in features like Smart Color Invert, Reduce Transparency Support, Cochlear Implant Support, Live Captions,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 10":
              - /url: "#footnote-10"
              - text: "10"
          - text: and Live Recognition, which can describe surroundings, find objects, and read documents in real time.
      - listitem:
        - img "Grey Apple logo with green leaf"
        - paragraph: Apple Vision Pro contains 100% recycled aluminum in the frame and battery enclosure.
        - paragraph:
          - link "Apple and the environment":
            - /url: /environment/

    - heading "An exciting new platform. A world of new opportunities for developers." [level=2]
    - paragraph: The opportunities for what developers can dream up and build for Apple Vision Pro are endless. And with familiar tools and frameworks like Xcode, SwiftUI, RealityKit, and ARKit, as well as support for Unity and the 3D-content preparation app Reality Composer Pro, developers have everything they need to create amazing spatial experiences.

    - region "Footnotes":
      - list:
        - listitem: "Testing conducted by Apple in August and September 2025 using preproduction Apple Vision Pro (M5) units and software. Testing consisted of full battery discharge while performing each of the following tasks: video playback, internet browsing, spatial video capture, and FaceTime. FaceTime tested between two Apple Vision Pro units with Personas enabled. Tested with Wi‑Fi associated to a network.
